uiMainApp.fame1UC:
Si vous achevez la mission avant la fin du round 7, vous pourrez gagner le nombre de récompenses affiché.

Après la mission, les récompenses peuvent être utilisées pour :
uiMainApp.fameItem1UC: • Piocher une carte Article additionnelle du paquet de votre choix pendant la séquence d'Amélioration Rebelle (coût: 1 Récompense par carte).
uiMainApp.fameItem2UC: • Piocher une carte Mission Annexe additionnelle et la mettre en jeu comme mission active (coût: 2 Récompenses par carte, maximum 2 cartes).
uiMainApp.fame2UC: Dès que le compteur de round atteint 8, les récompenses de mission sont mises à 0.

sagaMainApp.medpacInfoUC:
Un héros peut utiliser un Médipack lorsqu'il effectue une Action de Repos, et une figurine alliée peut utiliser un Médipack en tant qu'Action.

Lorsqu'une figurine utilise un Médipack, elle élimine 5 {H}. Les Médipacks peuvent être trouvés dans les Caisses.

uiTacticalAI.doctrineTreeLead: This card shows the figure's actions for this activation — it performs them in order. Reference rule: non-hero figures may perform only one attack per activation; heroes may use both actions for attacks. Cards with only one block hold their position.
uiTacticalAI.doctrineHeader: Doctrine: {0} — this rulebook governs your activation
uiTacticalAI.docAggressive: Advance (close into combat - one attack per activation)
uiTacticalAI.docGuard: Guard (hold the zone, never be lured out)
uiTacticalAI.docAmbusher: Ambush (stay unseen until the first shot)
uiTacticalAI.moveFocus: Move {0}: If a hero already stands inside your attack range: hold your ground and ready your fire. Otherwise: close in on {1} by up to {0} spaces while keeping him in sight
uiTacticalAI.moveFocusNoTarget: Move {0}: If a hero already stands inside your attack range: hold and ready fire. Otherwise: close in on the nearest hero by up to {0} spaces
uiTacticalAI.moveGuard: Move {0}: hold your position inside your guard zone (the mission objective you defend, plus its rim). A hero enters it: face him - but your move ALWAYS ends back inside the guard zone. Never be lured out
uiTacticalAI.moveBlocker: Move {0}: take the field between the mission objective and the nearest hero - his shortest route to the objective must cross your tile. Not reachable: hold the next chokepoint on his route
uiTacticalAI.moveSupport: Move {0}: keep your distance. Close in on {1} by at most {0} spaces and only if no hero would end up in melee reach of you; otherwise hold the distance
uiTacticalAI.moveAmbusher: Move {0}: only step onto tiles no hero can see - stay hidden until a target stands inside your range. First hero in range: attack
uiTacticalAI.attackFocus: Have you not attacked yet? Then: {0}, if in range with a clear line. No line / out of range: move up to {1} spaces toward {0}. Line blocked by ANOTHER hero: attack that blocking hero
uiTacticalAI.attackNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero you can shoot (range + clear line). No access: close in on the nearest hero
uiTacticalAI.attackGuard: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero INSIDE your guard zone (range + clear line). None inside but {0} is shootable: {0}. Neither: hold your ground, no shot
uiTacticalAI.attackGuardNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero inside your guard zone (range + clear line). None inside: hold, no shot
uiTacticalAI.attackAmbush: Have you not attacked yet? Then the ambush shot: the first hero you can shoot from here (range + clear line) - surprise beats target choice, even over {0}. Afterwards: do not unmask further
uiTacticalAI.attackAmbushNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then the ambush shot: the first hero you can shoot from here (range + clear line). Afterwards: stay masked
uiTacticalAI.attackSupport: Have you not attacked yet? Then: {0}, if in range with a clear line - prefer soft targets from cover. No line / out of range: back off instead of pushing in. Line blocked by ANOTHER hero: attack that blocking hero
uiTacticalAI.attackSupportNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the softest target you can shoot from cover (range + clear line). No target: back off
uiTacticalAI.attack2Move: {1} still inside your attack range? Hold cover and pre-aim for next activation. Otherwise: close in on {1} by up to {0} spaces while keeping him in sight
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveNoTarget: hold cover against the nearest hero or close in on him by up to {0} spaces
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveGuard: push up to {0} spaces against the nearest hero INSIDE your guard zone, or hold your position
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveAmbush: relocate to a tile no hero can see (up to {0}) - your next shot comes from new cover
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveBlocker: pick a new blocking tile between the mission objective and {1} (up to {0} spaces); no target: hold the chokepoint against the nearest hero
uiTacticalAI.attackSecondIntro: Check: if you already attacked this activation - a second attack is forbidden UNLESS your Imperial card explicitly allows multiple attacks (then repeat Aktion 1) - this block is a move: {0}
uiTacticalAI.attackSecondTail: If no attack has happened yet, this block counts as an Aktion-1 attack: shoot the target if possible; otherwise close in; shoot the line-blocker.
